messages:
sam: Quick async check — can each owner post a 1-line status on our Q2 delivery goals we discussed in the planning doc? shipped/slipped/blocker + next tiny step. I'll collate.
cheng: Shipping: model-serving latency work (v1): shipped to staged, perf looks good. Slipped: canary rollout delayed ~2d due to infra quota. Blocker: need quota bump from infra. Next: ping infra for quota (tom) @tom
anika: Shipping: obs dashboards for per-route latency + cost — shipped to feature flag. Slipped: alert thresholds still tuning. Blocker: none. Next: enable flag for beta customers Tues.
tom: Re infra quota — raised ticket #4521, infra said need capacity plan. Will post plan by EOD today. (reaction :eyes:)
jordan: Shipping: docs + SDK examples for routing policies — PRs merged. Slipped: none. Blocker: one flaky test failing in CI (failing on macos job). Next: retry CI, will revert test change if it flaps.
sam: Owner matrix for dependencies: cheng -> infra quota (tom), anika -> beta enablement (product ops), jordan -> docs/SDK follow-ups.
release-bot: deploy:scheduled: Canary rollout for serving v1 scheduled 2026-04-21T16:00Z
cheng: Quick ask — if canary needs rollback, what's the fallback model? We agreed on a smaller-quantized variant but need name. @jordan do we have model alias pinned?
jordan: We do: alias "serve-v1" points to rwd-serve-v1-2026-04-15. Fallback alias "serve-v1-safe" -> rwd-serve-v1-q4-quant. I can add a note to the rollout doc.
anika: For alerts, I’ll add a brief playbook: threshold, who to ping, and quick mitigation steps (cache clear, disable batching). Posting in this thread when done.
tom: Capacity plan: attaching short snippet here:
```
- expected qps: 28k
- headroom target: 30%
- requested GPUs: 12 x A100
- fallback: route to smaller quantized pool
```
I'll attach ticket link in infra ticket.
sam: OK — summary I'll use for the cross-team update: shipped: dashboards, docs, staged serving perf; slipped: canary by 2d, alerts tuning; blockers: infra quota + flaky CI. Next steps: tom posts capacity plan EOD, anika posts playbook, jordan pins fallback alias + rollout note. If anything changes, reply here. Thanks all :pray:
cheng: Noted, will hold canary until infra confirms. If infra can't meet, we fallback to limited region only. (reaction :thumbsup:)
jordan: Done — added alias note to rollout doc and linked in thread. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/rollouts/pull/88
anika: Playbook posted: https://docs.redwood/internal/runbooks/serving-canary (small edits incoming)
sam: I'll send the consolidated update to eng+product channel in ~1h unless objections. If you want other wording ping me now.
